description: This is a modern, minimalist lounge chair made entirely of bent plywood. The chair features a flowing, continuous design where the legs curve up to form the armrests and then seamlessly transition into the backrest. The bentwood construction gives it a sculptural quality, and the natural wood grain is visible, highlighting the material. A small, bright red tag with white text is affixed to the upper back of the chair. The design is elegant and simple, suggesting comfort and a contemporary aesthetic.
